title: Sora 2 System Card
summary: Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.
body: Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布Sora 2系统卡，介绍其为全新的顶尖视频和音频生成模型。该模型在物理真实感、画面锐度、同步音频、可控性及风格扩展性上取得了前代模型难以企及的突破，为多模态生成树立了新标杆。原始信息显示：Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Sora 2 System Card”。其重要性主要体现在：Sora 2系统卡的发布详细披露了该顶尖视频与音频生成模型的核心能力升级与物理模拟特性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

glossary.explanationZh: 系统卡，用于详细报告大模型的能力、限制、安全评估与测试结果的技术文档。
视频与音频生成模型，能够同时理解并生成高质量视觉影像与配套声音的多模态AI模型。
物理规律，在视频生成中指模型对现实世界物理交互和运动轨迹的拟真模拟能力。
可控性或引导性，指用户通过提示词或其他方式精准控制模型生成内容走向的能力。
